readme:
# Veo 3.1 Video Extend

Veo 3.1 video extend: continue an existing Veo clip by 7 seconds, keeping its subject, motion, and audio consistent.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 20,000 characters. |
| `video` | video URL, required | — | Clip to continue (a Veo-generated video works best). |
| `duration` | 7 | 7 | Output length in seconds. |
| `resolution` | `720p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `16:9` / `9:16` | — | Output frame shape. |
| `generate_audio` | boolean | true | Native dialogue, music, and effects; turning it off lowers the rate. |
| `negative_prompt` | string | — | What to avoid. |
| `seed` | integer 0–4294967295 | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

## Billing

You pay for output seconds, Google's list price. With audio: $0.40 at 720p. Without audio: $0.20 respectively.

| Output | 720p |
|---|---|
| 7s with audio (default) | $2.80 |
| 7s without audio | $1.40 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe what happens next, not what is already in the clip.

## Limits

- Each call adds 7 seconds at 720p; call again on the result to keep extending.
- Use Veo 3.1 Fast for cheaper drafts.

## Also on SandBase

Other Veo 3.1 endpoints: `google/veo3.1/text-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/image-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/first-last-frame-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/reference-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/fast/text-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/lite/text-to-video`.
